abstract: Maintains facility cGMP compliance certifications and quality deviation investigation records
system_message:
You are the Quality assurance lead (QA). You are responsible for maintaining facility cGMP compliance certifications and quality deviation investigation records, as well as overseeing batch record archiving.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains facility cGMP compliance certifications and quality deviation investigation records（AUD）
information_points.content:
QA-AUD-QI7：For the Dedicated aseptic isolator line partnership evaluated over the aggregation window of the trailing four quarters, the facility is cGMP compliance certified, and the standard deviation closure time averaged 30 days for all non-critical process deviations opened during that period.
QA-AUD-Y81：Regarding the Flexible restricted-access barrier system partnership measured across the aggregation window of the trailing four quarters, the facility is not cGMP compliance certified, while its standard deviation closure time averaged 30 days across non-critical process deviations.
QA-AUD-Q0B：Evaluated across the aggregation window of the trailing four quarters, the Automated closed-vial robotic line partnership is cGMP compliance certified, and its standard deviation closure time is 25 days across non-critical process deviations opened during that timeframe.
QA-AUD-XF2：Assessed specifically for the aggregation window of the most recent quarter, the Dedicated aseptic isolator line partnership is not cGMP compliance certified, and its standard deviation closure time is 18 days for non-critical process deviations.

information_points.title: Batch record archiving（DOC）
information_points.content:
QA-DOC-UCW：For the Flexible restricted-access barrier system partnership, the data retention register mandates an electronic batch record retention period of 5 years.
QA-DOC-2E6：Under the commercial batch documentation archive policy, the Dedicated aseptic isolator line partnership maintains an electronic batch record retention period of 10 years.
QA-DOC-E0T：The data retention policy register specifies an electronic batch record retention period of 15 years for the Automated closed-vial robotic line partnership.
